note: THE BURNTICKER CATEGORY TAXONOMY (2026-10-10). Browse is venue-agnostic: each category lists SOURCES from every adapter kind that maps to it — first-party feeds from config/burnticker/sources.json (matched by source id, the part before ':' for parameterised feeds), Polymarket tags (Gamma tag slugs, open events), and Kalshi categories (only while BURNTICKER_KALSHI_ENABLED is not 0). The page reads the same whether a venue is on or off; a category with no source on this host says so. Order here is the order on the page. sources-3 (2026-10-12, the owner: natural disasters promoted, weather de-emphasised): `disasters` comes first and lists the five hazard publishers, each with a per-event form and a one-shot on the next event; the weather tile is gone and the NWS climate rules sit under Science, Space & Weather. usgs.quakes6 stays unmapped (superseded by usgs.quakes). Copy is clinical: an instrument reading, never harm. `native` lists the first-party sources with their own code (sources/native.ts): espn:<league> team results (the Team coin picker) and nws:<metric> climate rules (a station + threshold form). `guided: elections` opens the race-type → state → race → outcome flow. `adjudicatedOnly` marks a category with no qualifying first-party source: only adjudicated markets (Polymarket) are listed, and the page says so rather than inventing a source.
